LanguageData.NMC_S01.label: Warp energy field
LanguageData.NMC_S01.description:
Establish a warp energy field at the selected position, powering friendly devices within 8 cells and restoring allies' energy. Total output is 10,000 W; units recover 20% of their maximum energy per second.
Only one field can exist at a time. Initial deployment costs 1,000 P and 500 V; relocating an existing field costs 100 P and 50 V. Upkeep is 1 P and 1 V every 0.1 day. The field shuts down if reserves are insufficient.
After researching cross-domain personnel warp, colonists can warp directly to the field. Deployment and relocation always have a 1-minute cooldown, regardless of this research.
LanguageData.NMC_S02.label: Orbital strike
LanguageData.NMC_S02.description:
Direct the mothership's orbital strikes. While aiming, click repeatedly to choose impact points. Each successful shot costs energy; ending targeting stops the attack.
Each shot affects a 3×3 square centered on the impact (9 cells), deals 30 base damage, penetrates 35% armor and deals 5 times damage to buildings. Blast damage does not fall off with distance. Cannot be used underground or directly hit targets under thick rock roofs.
After researching precision ally recognition, the commander's direct fire avoids your faction and allies.
LanguageData.NMC_S03.label: Shield overload
LanguageData.NMC_S03.description:
Give temporary shields to friendly units and buildings present on this map when cast, for 30 seconds. Each receives 200 shield points to absorb damage remaining after armor.
Allies arriving later receive no shield. A building also under building overload can have both shields, up to 400 total. Shields can be ended early, without refunding energy or cooldown.
LanguageData.NMC_S04.label: Solar bombardment
LanguageData.NMC_S04.description:
Call sustained orbital bombardment. Over 30 seconds, 300 energy shells strike an area with radius 13. Each blast affects a 3×3 square centered on the impact (9 cells), deals 30 base damage and 5 times damage to buildings, with no distance falloff.
Useful against dense fortifications. Once started, it cannot be stopped; move allies away first. Cannot be used underground or directly strike targets under thick rock roofs.
LanguageData.NMC_S05.label: Solar ray gun
LanguageData.NMC_S05.description:
Project three solar rays for 8 seconds. They prefer separate enemy targets but may converge on one when few remain. Targets along their path take continuous energy and burn damage.
Choose an origin to begin. Rays on the current map can be ended early. Cannot be used underground; thick rock roofs block strikes. Ending does not refund energy or reset cooldown.
LanguageData.NMC_S06.label: Spacetime fluctuation
LanguageData.NMC_S06.description:
For 60 seconds on every colony map:
1. All friendly pawns and animals move at ×2 speed. 2. All friendly units research, build, grow, mine, tend and craft at ×10 work speed. 3. All friendly turrets, including hyperdimensional monoliths, have one-third attack cooldown. 4. Nivarian buildings work at ×10 speed, including uplink research and automated manufacturing.
P and V production from energy towers, particle collectors and similar facilities is unchanged. Each map follows local time; end the effect early from the commander panel.
LanguageData.NMC_S07.label: Purification beam
LanguageData.NMC_S07.description:
Drop a mobile purification beam from orbit. Radius 4, duration 20 seconds, movement 3 cells per second. It pursues enemies automatically and deals continuous energy and burn damage along its path.
Draft it to direct movement manually; undrafting restores automatic pursuit. Cannot be used underground; thick rock blocks strikes. Early termination does not refund energy or cooldown.
LanguageData.NMC_S08.label: Shadow core
LanguageData.NMC_S08.description:
Warp in a Nivarian shadow energy tower construct. Deliver 150 steel, 4 components and 25 dragon crystals; the native construction system prints the tower in 20 seconds at base speed.
A nutrient-fed energy facility with ghost-green resonant crystals, occupying 2×2 cells. Generates 1400 W; P output and nutrition consumption are twice those of the Nivarian energy tower. Colonists deliver allowed food. Adjust supplies in the Nutrition tab.
While operating, cloaks allies in the combined area of four circles, each with a radius of 7 cells and centered on one of the tower’s 2×2 occupied cells. Select the tower to see the boundary. Insufficient nutrition, switching off or interrupted operation stops electricity, P production and cloaking together; replenishing nutrition restores operation. Attacks and damage do not break cloaking, but detection still works.
The tower does not cloak itself and needs other defenses.
LanguageData.NMC_S09.label: Shadow guard
LanguageData.NMC_S09.description:
Request four shadow guards for 120 seconds. These melee specialists wear ghost armor and carry biocoded masterwork weapons. They can attack while invisible, but detection still reveals them.
Requires a surviving, non-hostile Nivarian survivors faction. Guards choose their own targets and cannot be drafted. Members and equipment still carried withdraw when support ends.
LanguageData.NMC_S10.label: Black hole
LanguageData.NMC_S10.description:
Create an 8-second gravity vortex. Enemies within 8 cells are pulled to its center at 12 cells per second and temporarily lose all armor. Downed and airborne enemies are affected too.
The black hole itself deals no damage. Use it to gather scattered enemies for other attacks. It can be ended early.
LanguageData.NMC_S11.label: Time stop
LanguageData.NMC_S11.description:
Stop movement and attacks of enemies present in all colonies when cast, for 30 seconds. Affects enemy creatures, mechanoids, drones and turrets.
Enemies arriving later are unaffected. Restraint ends immediately if a target leaves or becomes friendly. Injuries and diseases continue progressing. All colonies' effects can be ended early.
LanguageData.NMC_S12.label: Building overload
LanguageData.NMC_S12.description:
Turn a friendly building into a defensive firing point for 45 seconds, with a 200-point shield and blue laser. The laser attacks every 0.5 seconds for 10 base damage.
Each use consumes one overload charge. Charges start at zero, recover one every 3 days, and cap at three. Cancelling early does not refund energy, charges or cooldown.
LanguageData.NMC_S12.extraCost: Also consumes 1 overload charge per use
LanguageData.NMC_S13.label: Nivarian fleet
LanguageData.NMC_S13.description:
Call one tactical mothership and eight destroyers. The fleet fights automatically in flight and stays for 120 seconds after all ships arrive.
The mothership attacks with lasers and energy shells. Destroyer prism beams gain damage while continuously hitting the same target, resetting after switching targets or interruption. They do not freeze targets.
Support ships can be destroyed by enemy fire. Ships, wrecks and dropped items are recalled when support ends.
LanguageData.NMC_S14.label: Tebrus legion
LanguageData.NMC_S14.description:
Request Tebrus and ten melee warriors for 120 seconds. Tebrus uses a psionic pulse gun and casts psionic storms against clustered enemies. Storms burn enemies and heal allies within range.
Requires non-hostile Nivarian survivors. The legion fights independently and cannot be drafted. Members and exclusive equipment are recovered on departure. All three expedition legions share a 7-day cooldown.
LanguageData.NMC_S15.label: Zoraya legion
LanguageData.NMC_S15.description:
Call command ship Zoraya and four glowships. They fight automatically for 120 seconds after arrival, using prism beams that freeze enemies and gain damage while locked on one target.
Requires non-hostile Nivarian survivors. Ships, wrecks and dropped items are recovered afterwards. All three expedition legions share a 7-day cooldown.
LanguageData.NMC_S16.label: Seydas legion
LanguageData.NMC_S16.description:
Request Seydas and three dark archons for 120 seconds. They use mind control, preferring valuable enemies, to recruit them into the Nivarian survivors faction. Controlled units do not become your colonists and remain with that faction after the legion leaves.
Requires non-hostile Nivarian survivors. Autonomous combat, no drafting. The four members and exclusive gear are recovered when leaving. All three legions share a 7-day cooldown.
LanguageData.NMC_S17.label: Hyperdimensional monolith
LanguageData.NMC_S17.description:
Warp in a Nivarian hyperdimensional monolith construct. Deliver 300 steel, 10 components and 60 dragon crystals; the native construction system prints the monolith in 45 seconds at base speed.
Requires 1,000 W, no ammunition. Every 2 seconds it attacks up to 10 enemies within 60 cells, dealing 3 base damage and stunning each for 1 second. Useful for delaying mass advances.
LanguageData.NMC_S18.label: Void suppression crystal
LanguageData.NMC_S18.description:
Warp in a void suppression crystal for 30 seconds. Within 18 cells, enemies' movement and attack speeds drop to 30%, and enemy turrets stop firing.
The crystal cannot be destroyed by attacks. Enemies recover immediately on leaving range. Effects of multiple crystals do not stack. Crystals can be recalled early.
The crystal occupies no ground space and does not block movement. It can be deployed on any terrain and overlap buildings, units, items and plants.
LanguageData.NMC_S19.label: Hyperdimensional matrix projection
LanguageData.NMC_S19.description:
Project registered friendly turrets within 20 cells of the chosen center. Projections form in 5 seconds and fight for 60 seconds. If space is limited, only turrets that fit are projected.
Projections start with half their source's current HP and use its power, fuel and ammunition. Sources cease fire during projection but can still be damaged and repaired. Projection damage is also applied to the source; choose positions carefully.
Projections cannot be repaired or moved. Register, unregister or recall them from the turret. Early recall refunds neither energy nor cooldown.
Also supports defense drone hubs (Orbit, Strafing and Recon). Native construction effects form only at the destination. Cooldown: 2 days. Cost: 300P and 100V. Source drones are recalled; their existing batteries supply the projection, and remaining charge returns on recall.
